trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==2 for v in grid[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))]
    if not rows and cols:
        t=transform([list(x) for x in zip(*grid)])
        return [list(x) for x in zip(*t)]
    if not rows:
        rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and grid[r][0]!=0]
    regions=[]
    bounds=[-1]+rows+[h]
    for a,b in zip(bounds,bounds[1:]):
        if b<=a+1: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(a+1,b) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
        if not pts: continue
        y0=min(r for r,c in pts);y1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        x0=min(c for r,c in pts);x1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        regions.append([row[x0:x1+1] for row in grid[y0:y1+1]])
    if not regions:return [row[:] for row in grid]
    width=max(len(p[0]) for p in regions)
    out=[]
    for p in regions:
        d=width-len(p[0]);left=d//2
        out.extend([[0]*left+row+[0]*(d-left) for row in p])
    return out
